description: Converting landscape (16:9) footage to vertical (9:16) for TikTok/YouTube Shorts/Instagram Reels
critical_rule: ALL short-form clips MUST be in 9:16 vertical format

auto_reframe.method: Paste YouTube link → Select TikTok ratio → Auto reframe
auto_reframe.note: AI detects the speaker/subject and keeps them centered
auto_reframe.when_to_use: Quick batch processing, podcast clips, interview clips

manual_reframe_capcut.method: Change canvas ratio to 9:16 → Resize/crop the clip to fit
steps: 3. Scale up clip to fill vertical frame (usually 2.5x zoom)
4. Position subject in center of frame
5. Add blurred background to fill remaining space

smart_crop.when_to_use: Multiple speakers, wide shots, dynamic scenes

blur_background_technique.purpose: When cropping 16:9 to 9:16, the original edges are lost. To fill the frame aesthetically:
method: 2. Scale up the bottom layer to fill entire 9:16 frame
3. Apply heavy blur to the bottom layer (40-60px)
4. Keep top layer at normal size, centered on subject
5. Result: blurred version fills edges, sharp subject in center
blur_background_technique.alternative: Use CapCut Canvas → Blur background feature
blur_background_technique.intensity: Moderate blur - enough to not distract, enough to fill space

tiktok.max_duration: 10 minutes (but sweet spot 20-40 seconds for clips)
